title: MOFjson: An Explicit Topological Representation of Metal-Organic Frameworks for Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.34549v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language models for metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) rely on formats that separate atomic geometry from structural topology, forcing models to choose between unstructured coordinate lists and non-spatial string identifiers[1]. We present MOFjson, the first representation separating structural data into a raw atomic layer with explicit bond shift vectors and a derived layer exposing secondary building units (metal nodes and organic linkers) and network topology. Additionally, we introduce a benchmark with crystal-derived ground truth across four question categories. Across four models, MOFjson beats all three baselines in every category: 100% vs. 18-47% on reaching a block's nearest periodic copy, 96% vs. 71% on crystal system characterisation, and 60% vs. 48% on metal node and organic linker coordination. translated_title: MOFjson：一种面向语言模型的金属有机框架显式拓扑表示
translated_abstract: 用于金属有机框架（MOFs）的语言模型目前所依赖的格式将原子几何与结构拓扑相分离，迫使模型在非结构化的坐标列表和非空间性的字符串标识符之间做出选择。我们提出了MOFjson，这是首个将结构数据分离为两层的表示方法：一层是包含显式键移矢量的原始原子层，另一层是暴露次级结构单元（金属节点和有机连接体）及网络拓扑的派生层。此外，我们引入了一个涵盖四个问题类别、具有晶体来源真值标签的基准测试。在四个模型上的实验表明，MOFjson在所有类别中均超越了三个基线方法：在判断一个结构块的最近周期性副本任务上达到100%对18-47%，在晶系表征任务上达到96%对71%，在金属节点和有机连接体配位任务上达到60%对48%。消融实验显示，移除移位标签后准确率降至12.7%，证明模型读取的是周期性图结构而非表面格式。MOFjson为语言模型提供了……
tldr: MOFjson首次提出将MOF结构分离为包含显式键移矢量的原始原子层与暴露次级结构单元和网络拓扑的派生层，使语言模型在MOF结构理解的各项任务上大幅超越现有基线。
en_tdlr: MOFjson is the first representation that separates MOF structural data into a raw atomic layer with explicit bond shift vectors and a derived layer exposing secondary building units and network topology, enabling language models to substantially outperform existing baselines across MOF structure understanding tasks.
